note: Every category auto-publishes by default, politics included (changed 2026-09-28, was: politics/jobs/education review_required by category). Review is now governed purely by escalation_keywords — a topic that's actually about religion/caste/communal tension, or one of the other listed triggers, still needs review no matter which category it's filed under; nothing else does.
autoPublishNote: While false, promote-topics.js refuses to auto-approve anything and EVERY topic waits for a checkbox in the review issue, regardless of the auto_publish list below. Flip to true only once the pipeline's output quality has been observed for a while — the list is a plan, not a live rule, until then.
escalationNote: An auto_publish topic matching any keyword is promoted to review_required. A cricket topic about a match-fixing arrest must not auto-publish. Kept intentionally broader than just religion/caste/communal — court/verdict/arrest/death/riot/election/boycott/ban are all still legally or reputationally sensitive enough to warrant a human look, even now that category alone no longer forces review.
